intro: If you have a concert, trade fair or exhibition at IMPACT Muang Thong Thani and want the closest cheap bed to the halls — somewhere you can walk back to at midnight without chasing a taxi — IMPACT Muang Thong Thani Service Condo in Popular Condo T8 answers that need better than anything else at this price · It sits in Building T8 of the Popular Condo complex on Popular 3 Road, roughly 700 metres from the IMPACT halls — an 8-12 minute walk through the estate footpath · Rooms are proper condo-style with a kitchenette (fridge, microwave, kettle), free Wi-Fi, free parking in the complex and 24-hour card-key security · Prices start from approx. ฿700/night — the lowest in the IMPACT cluster by a comfortable margin · The honest trade-off is that this is a real residential condo rented out by the night, not a managed hotel: there is no 24-hour front desk, signage inside the complex is poor, and cleanliness varies by unit · Read the review below to decide if it suits you.

body.html: IMPACT Muang Thong Thani Service Condo occupies the 4th floor of Building T8 in the Popular Condo complex on Popular 3 Road, Ban Mai, Pak Kret, Nonthaburi · It is a set of individually owned condo units rented out on a nightly basis — which is both the source of its value and the reason guests need clear expectations before booking · The single biggest advantage, confirmed by every positive review, is the distance: roughly 700 metres from the IMPACT event halls, a walk of about 8-12 minutes along the footpath through the estate · Anyone who has ever been stuck outside an IMPACT hall after midnight — 500 people ahead of you queuing for Grab, taxis circling and inflating fares — will understand exactly what that 8-minute walk home is worth · On top of that, the 2025 opening of MRT Pink Line station MT01 Impact Muang Thong Thani (with a 230-metre skywalk straight to Challenger Hall) now makes getting to IMPACT by public transport far easier even without a car.

Rooms are condo-style rather than hotel-style: each has a kitchenette with microwave, fridge and electric kettle, a flat-screen TV, air conditioning, free Wi-Fi, complimentary bottled water and a hairdryer · Most units have a separate sitting area with a desk, making them more comfortable for a multi-night stay than a comparable-price hotel room · Positive reviews consistently highlight the price, the walkable location and the warmth of the owner, known as May, who speaks both Thai and English and is described as genuinely welcoming and responsive · The flip side is that units vary: some reviews mention dusty or musty-smelling cabinets and bathrooms that could be cleaner, and the experience depends noticeably on which specific unit you get.
"Great location — walked to IMPACT in minutes, price was the lowest anywhere near the venue. May (the owner) was warm and helpful. The food court right across the building is a bonus."

The Popular Condo T8 complex itself has some genuine perks that regular guests mention · A large food court sits directly across from Building T8, with a wide range of Thai dishes at local prices — around 45-80 baht per plate, dramatically cheaper than any hotel restaurant in the area · Free parking is included in the complex, card-key access controls entry and exit, 24-hour security guards patrol the grounds and CCTV covers the common areas · Don Muang Airport is only about 10-12 km away, roughly 15-20 minutes by car, which makes this a practical overnight base when catching an early or late flight to or from Don Muang · The repeated warning in reviews, however, is clear: signage inside the complex is poor and room numbers are not prominently displayed — first-time visitors often struggle to find the right unit, especially at night · Always contact the owner before arrival to confirm the exact room location and key handover.

On getting around: the MRT Pink Line station MT01 (Impact Muang Thong Thani) opened in May 2025 and is roughly a 10-minute walk from Building T8 · From the station, a 230-metre covered skywalk leads straight to IMPACT Challenger Hall without stepping outside · For guests with a car, the complex provides free parking · The overall guest score sits around 7.1 from real reviews across platforms — honest for what this place is: a budget condo rental with a location advantage that no hotel in its price bracket can match, but with service and consistency well below a managed hotel · It is not a bad place; it is a specific kind of place for a specific kind of traveller.

Honestly, IMPACT Muang Thong Thani Service Condo is the right choice when your goal is to walk back from the IMPACT halls at the lowest possible cost and you are comfortable with a residential condo rather than a managed hotel · For a one-night concert trip with a tight budget, a group that wants a kitchenette, or anyone arriving late from Don Muang who needs a cheap bed nearby, it delivers well on that narrow brief · But if you need a staffed front desk, a hotel restaurant, a pool or reliable housekeeping standards, step up to Botanic Service Room or ibis Bangkok IMPACT — both cost more, but deliver a much smoother stay for guests who need that kind of consistency.

Tips from tracking the reviews over time: always message the owner (May) at least a day before you arrive — confirm the exact room number, the floor and how you will collect the key, especially if you plan to arrive after a late show · Ask ahead whether car parking is available on event days, since the complex can fill up during major IMPACT events · For food, the large food court directly opposite Building T8 runs all day and into the evening at extremely low local prices — use it instead of venturing further · Compare prices across Agoda, Booking.com and Trip.com before you book, as each platform prices this property differently, especially around event weeks.

faqTitle: FAQ — IMPACT Muang Thong Thani Service Condo (Popular Condo T8)

faq.q: Where is IMPACT Muang Thong Thani Service Condo and can you really walk to the event halls?
faq.a: It's in Popular Condo Building T8, 4th Floor, Popular 3 Road, Ban Mai, Pak Kret, Nonthaburi · The IMPACT halls are roughly 700 metres away — an 8-12 minute walk along the footpath through the estate · In 2025 the Pink Line MRT station MT01 opened nearby (about 10 min walk), with a 230 m covered skywalk directly to Challenger Hall · Don Muang Airport is about 10-12 km away, roughly 15-20 minutes by road.

faq.q: What is the starting price and what room types are available?
faq.a: Prices start from approx. ฿700/night for a standard condo-style room off-peak, rising to around ฿900-1,100 on major IMPACT event dates · All rooms include a kitchenette with fridge, microwave and kettle · Larger rooms with King or Twin beds are available, suitable for small groups · This is the lowest-priced option within walking distance of IMPACT — compare rates across Agoda, Booking.com and Trip.com before you book as each platform prices differently.

faq.q: Who is this place best for — and who should look elsewhere?
faq.a: Best for: concert-goers, trade-fair and exhibition visitors on a tight budget who want to walk back to their room after a late show; groups or families who want a kitchenette; anyone making a quick stop near Don Muang Airport · Not ideal for: anyone who needs a 24-hour front desk, hotel restaurant, pool, or consistent hotel-standard cleanliness — in that case, Botanic Service Room or ibis Bangkok IMPACT will serve you better.

faq.q: How does check-in work — is there a reception desk?
faq.a: No — this is a residential condo, not a hotel, so there is no permanent front desk · You must contact the owner (May) before arrival to confirm your exact room number, floor and how to collect the key · It is strongly recommended to do this at least a day ahead, especially if you plan to arrive after a late event.

faq.q: Is there parking, and can you get to IMPACT without a car?
faq.a: Free parking is available inside the Popular Condo complex · Without a car: the MRT Pink Line station MT01 (Impact Muang Thong Thani) is about 10 minutes on foot from Building T8 — the station has a 230 m covered skywalk directly to Challenger Hall, meaning no sun or rain · Alternatively, a Grab or Bolt ride to the IMPACT halls costs around ฿40-60 and takes 2-3 minutes.
